featured_reviews.name: Anish Tigga
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at Bliss PG (Kasthuri Group) for 1 year and 2 months, and it was a really good experience. The owner, Mr. Prasad Parab, is very supportive and responsive. Whenever there was any issue, he made sure it was resolved quickly, which made the stay very comfortable.

One thing I really appreciated was the cleanliness and maintenance. The rooms and toilets were cleaned every single day, which is something not every PG maintains consistently. The overall service and management were well organized, making it a pleasant place to stay.

Another positive aspect was the friendly and respectful living environment. I had the opportunity to share the room with Saurabh, who was very cooperative and considerate, which contributed to a comfortable and pleasant stay.

If anyone is looking for a well-maintained PG with responsible management, cleanliness, and a positive living environment, I would recommend Bliss PG. Thank you, Mr. Prasad Parab, for providing such a good living experience. Wishing you continued success and many more happy residents!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Update on my last stay:
I had a very bad experience. I have been visiting this place for many years, and it has helped me by providing an affordable place to stay, for which I was always grateful. I adjusted to the conditions without any complaints.

However, during my last visit, I had an argument with a staff member, and unfortunately, the owner took the staff’s side. Everyone knows that this particular staff member (the Marwadi guy) is often rude to customers, yet the owner didn’t seem to care about the customer’s experience in this case.

I have never created any issues in the past. Many guests drink and cause disturbances, but regulars like me adjust and stay peacefully.
I’ve seen others create much bigger problems, yet the owner allowed them to continue staying.
In my case, despite being a regular and peaceful guest, when the issue involved that rude staff member, I was treated unfairly.

A message to the owner:
Please remember — a business runs because of its customers. If the staff is rude and arrogant, it creates a negative environment, and people won’t want to visit again.
Still, I acknowledge that the owner is a good and helpful person.
I hope you take this review seriously.
Thank you.

Cleanliness was clearly not a priority, as the washroom was unhygienic and rarely cleaned properly. Basic facilities like WiFi and hot water were either not working or extremely unreliable, which made daily life very inconvenient. The management was unresponsive and dismissive whenever issues were raised, and instead of resolving problems, they would make excuses. The food quality was below average, often cold and repetitive, with no attention to hygiene or taste. On top of that, the overall environment felt uncomfortable and poorly managed, with frequent noise disturbances and no proper security measures. For the amount being charged, the service and facilities provided are absolutely not worth it. I would not recommend this PG to anyone looking for a comfortable and stress-free stay

featured_reviews.review_text:

The location is perfect, metro and daily needs are close by. Security is solid with CCTV and gated society. If there’s any issue, the management is quick to fix it.

Overall, a really safe, comfortable, and value-for-money PG option. Definitely recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.name: vault w3ar
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at this paying guest accommodation was extremely disappointing from day one. The rooms were cramped, poorly ventilated, and far from clean. Dust, stains, and broken fixtures made it clear that maintenance is neglected here. The washrooms were unhygienic, and housekeeping was either irregular or done carelessly. Despite raising multiple complaints, the management showed zero accountability and never provided proper solutions. The food served was repetitive, tasteless, and sometimes even cold. Considering the high rent they charge, the quality of service and living conditions are unacceptable. I regret choosing this place and would strongly advise others to think twice before staying here.

featured_reviews.name: WinNie
featured_reviews.review_text: Saavee is on the main road, overviewing one lake and the Vasai creek. The man made lake seems like a pond for breeding of fish was usually close and access seemed private. The team which runs saavee on ground i.e. the caretaker (Mukesh and raj I think, from darbangha, up) said they were unaware of it being locked. We reached on Friday evening just before sunset and spent the evening roaming the beach side (about 10-20 mins of drive). We sat at dining area of saavee, playing with the kittens and just enjoying the view of the creek. Mind you, that's the only best place for the view, the rooms don't have a view of the sea/ lake or forest. The rooms (3 nos, 1 bedroom and wash) has a view of a small ground inside saavee. They have a 2bhk villa kind, which may have some lake view, but that was occupied, so I don't know. It was beautiful as Friday was quiet just by us and we were very happy playing with kitten. They don't serve food, they serve chai with biscuit/ toasted bread and poha/ bread-omlette, that's about it. So meals you can either get it delivered or ask the boys to pick it a cost. We chose to drive and explore the place. Post dinner we Walked around the property with the lights, it was beautiful, no doubt. We called it an early night, and were up in the morning by sunrise. The birds were chirping and it was so good to be back away from mumbai, to hear birds, different kind. The wind was crisp and chilly. The plan was to have breakfast and our meals out and also to explore the nearby areas. Mukesh arrived soon after a swim in the pool, with chai and toast. He makes good chai. We left for our tour, around which was to the breakfast point, famous auntee vada pav, vellankani church, lady sea church, lunch at local place, took a quick rest at saavee, played some tt, fed the kitten with some cat food, dongri fort, dargah, botanical garden keshav srishti, drive on gorai beach and finally dinner at dariya ke kinaare  (you will find review on the same). We also did shop some local footmat, hand bags, and had sugarcane juice. Mind you, there are old traditional steel/ glass available which you should insist over disposable plates and glasses. Do not try the ice cream at the medical shop at dongri, I forgot the name. It sells duplicate ice cream , where you can taste and smell oil. But the market nearby has several great options, but go for amul, and do not try to experiment which we did. Saavee has filtered water if you insist, pls don't use plastic bottles and disposable glasses, which they give. The water in pool  is cold, so make sure you take a shower in the water nearby, it will help your body to adjust with the cold water easily. We checked out of Sunday after chai-toast and headed to a museum of a local freedom fighter known as kaka's east indian musuem. Ohh we had breakfast at stella aunty dhaba, which is a 10 min drive from saavee towards the beach. When you head back do not miss to buy local fruits and vegetables, homegrown. They are organically, real time grown compare to the nearby cities.  The washroom are small and neat. They provided clean towels and always responded to our calls. The furniture is adequate in the room, and of Good quality. There are no windows and hence it could get stuffy. Since it is near to the creek and lot of greenery, mosquito are common. They also have a locked parking, so you can be rest assured of the safety of your vehicles. Very centrally located from other points of interest.
